printed_text: Add 1 "Vir Pedicae Mortis" monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only activate 1 "Recollection: Static, Lead and Nerve" per turn.

card: Vir Pedicae Mortis - Entity's Happy Servant
printed_text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can discard 1 card or send 1 face-up "Recollection" card you control to the GY; add 1 "Recollection" card, and 1 card that is either "Bear Trap" or a "Mortis" card, from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Vir Pedicae Mortis - Entity's Happy Servant" once per turn. While you control "Pedicae's Papa", "Recollection" cards and "Mine" Field Spells you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by placing 2 Aqua Monsters from your GY on the bottom of your Deck in any order. You can treat this card as a Level 1 monster when you Xyz Summon an Aqua monster. You can discard 1 card; shuffle this card from your hand into the Deck, then add 1 "Exploring the Nautical Waters" from your Deck to your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can draw 1 card, then, immediately after this effect resolves, your opponent Normal or Special Summons 1 monster from their hand in Attack Position, but its ATK becomes 0.

If this card is in your hand: You can discard 1 card; shuffle this card face-up into your opponent's Deck, also, add 1 "Stain" card from your Deck to your hand, then, if your opponent controls more cards than you, draw 1 card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 card in either GY or banishment; place it on the bottom of the Deck, or, if it is your "Stain" card, add it to the hand instead, and if you do, shuffle this card into the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Stained Bird Bria" once per turn.

Monsters your opponent controls lose 500 ATK for each "Vir Pedicae Mortis" monster you control. Once per turn: You can banish 1 card from your GY, then discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 "Pedicae's Papa" or 1 "Vir Pedicae Mortis" monster from your Deck, then add 1 "Recollection: Kaboom Papa" from your Deck to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Recollection: The Mine" per turn.

This card is treated as "Wicked Puppeteer Orchis" and a Ritual monster while on the field. If this card is Normal Summoned: You can discard 1 card; add 1 "Wicked Puppeteer Orchis" and 1 "Wicked Puppeteer Tragedy" from your Deck, GY, or banishment to your hand. If a monster whose original name is "Wicked Puppeteer Orchis" you control leaves the field because of your opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon this card from your GY, then you can Special Summon 1 "Puppet Token" (DARK/Warrior/Level 4/ATK 1500/DEF 200). You can only use each effect of "The True Wicked Puppeteer, Orchis" once per turn.

If this card is in your hand: You can destroy 1 "Vylon" Card from your hand or field, then Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Vylon" monster and 1 "Vylon" Spell Card from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. If this card is sent to the GY for the Synchro Summon of a LIGHT monster: You can Special Summon 1 "Vylon" monster from your hand or GY. You can only use each effect of "Vylon Torus" once per turn.

2 monsters, including an "Aldrez" monster
You can treat this card as a Level 4 monster when you Xyz Summon a Rank 4 Xyz Monster. You can only use the following effects of "Knight of Aldrez" once per turn. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 card; take 1 "Aldrez" card from your Deck, and either add it to your hand, or if it is a monster, you can Special Summon it. If an "Aldrez" Xyz Monster is sent to the GY by an opponent's card: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon that monster, then you can attach 1 card from either GY to it.

If you control a FIRE Dragon monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your GY). You can only Special Summon "Guardian of Fire" once per turn this way. You can send this card from your hand to the GY, then discard 1 card; add 1 monster that lists "Phlogiston Dragon" in its text from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Guardian of Fire" once per turn. FIRE Dragon monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle.

You can discard 1 card; Special Summon this card from your GY. If this card is Special Summoned: You can return 1 monster your opponent controls to the hand. You can only use each effect of "Killamity Azure" once per turn. A Rank 12 Xyz Monster that has this card as material gains the following effect.
● Up to twice per turn, if a Level/Rank 12 monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can detach 1 material from this card instead.

During your Main Phase, if this card is in your hand (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 "Stain" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck using "Stain" monsters that mention "Shuffle this card face-up into your opponent's Deck" from your hand or field as material. If this card is sent to the GY: You can discard 1 card and send 1 "Stain" card from your Deck to the GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Stained Scioness Silia" once per turn.

If this card is discarded to the GY: Special Summon this card. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 "Arckcestial" monster from your hand, then discard 1 card. If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material for a LIGHT monster: You can add 1 "Arckcestial" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Arckcestial Fireball" once per turn.

1 "Protogenic Essence Token"
You can only Link Summon "To Proto Archegoni" once per turn. If this card is Link Summoned: You can discard 1 card; add 1 Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand that lists "To Proto" in its text or name. (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your field or GY, then target 1 Galaxy Monster you control; that target cannot be destroyed by battle or your opponent's card effects until the end of this turn.

If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a Fairy monster: You can add 1 Level 4 or lower Fairy monster from your Deck to your hand. You cannot Special Summon the turn you use this effect, except LIGHT monsters. During the Main Phase: You can discard 1 card; Special Summon this card from your GY, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Oracle of the Herald" once per turn.

2 Level 4 "Arckcestial" monsters
If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can add 1 "Arckcestial" Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand. If a card or effect is activated that targets an "Arckcestial" card(s) on the field, while this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 "Arckcestial" monster; Special Summon this card. If this card is detached from an "Arckcestial" Xyz Monster to activate that monster's effect: You can target 1 "Arckcestial" Spell/Trap in your GY; add it to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Ophiel, Arckcestial of Wisdom" once per turn.

When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Arckcestial" monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except LIGHT Spellcaster monsters. Once per turn, if your opponent Normal or Special Summons a non-LIGHT monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You target 1 "Arckcestial" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only activate 1 "Arckcestial Meadow" per turn.

You can Ritual Summon this card with "Glitchling Data-Transfert". Monsters your opponent controls lose 200 ATK/DEF for each Corruption Counter on them. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Bitron" from your hand, Deck, or GY. During the Main Phase, if this card is in your hand or field (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 card, then send 1 "Glitchling" Spell/Trap Card from your Deck to the GY; apply that card's activation effect, then you can place 1 Corruption Counter on a card on the field. You can only use each effect of "Glitchling Bitron" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon the turn you activate either of these effects except Cyberse Ritual, Cyberse Normal, "Glitchling" and Extra Deck Monsters.

"Thunder Dragon" + 1 Thunder monster Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned by banishing 1 Thunder monster from your hand and 1 Thunder monster you control, except "Thunder Dragon Behemoth" (in which case you do not use "Polymerization"). If this card is Special Summoned: You can add up to 2 "Thunder Dragon" cards from your Deck to your hand, and if you do, discard 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Thunder Dragon Behemoth" once per turn. If this card would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish 1 Thunder monster from your GY instead.

During your Main Phase: You can discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Arckcestial" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except LIGHT Spellcaster monsters. If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro material for a LIGHT monster: You can target 1 of your banished "Arckcestial" cards; add it to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Arckcestial Crystal Shards" once per turn.

(Quick Effect) : You can discard 1 "Nemleria" card; add 1 "Dreaming Nemleria" from your Deck to your Extra Deck face-up and Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can return 1 card your opponent controls that began the Duel in the Main Deck to the hand. You can only use the previous effect of "Nemleria Dream Creator - Pyjama" once per turn. Up to thrice per turn, if you have "Dreaming Nemleria" face-up in your Extra Deck (Quick Effect) : You can banish 2 cards from your Extra Deck face-down (except "Dreaming Nemleria") and target 1 other "Nemleria" card you control; it is unaffected by the cards and effects activated before this effect in this Chain.

Add 1 "Grand Blue" card from your Deck to your hand, then, if you control "Umi", you can send 1 "Grand Blue" card from your hand or Deck to the GY. If a "Grand Blue" monster leaves your GY by an opponent's card effect, while this card is in the GY: You can add this card to your hand, then you can discard 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Brilliance of the Grand Blue" once per turn.

At the start of your Main Phase 1: Discard 2 cards; return all monsters on the field to the hand. If this face-up card is sent from the field to the GY: Draw cards (max. 2) equal to the number of monsters on the field. You cannot activate cards or effects in response to the activation of this card and its effects.

2 Thunder monsters including an "Ohmen" monster
This card's ATK becomes 0 while it has no Current Counters. Gains these effects based on the number of Current Counters on it:
●1+: During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Ohmen" monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card.
●2+: During your Main Phase: You can place 1 Current Counter on each monster co-linked to this card.
●3+: "Ohmenchanic" monsters co-linked to this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.
You can only use each effect of "Ampere, the Ohmenchanic Intensity" once per turn.

Cannot be used as Xyz or Link Material, except the Xyz or Link Summon of a "Grayscale" monster. You can only use each of the following effects of "Grayhex the Chanter of Grayscale" once per turn. During the Main Phase, if you control no monsters or only "Grayscale" monsters (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can take 1 "Grayscale" card from your Deck, and either add it to your hand or send it to the GY. If a "Grayscale" monster is Normal or Special Summoned to your field while this card is in your GY: You can discard 1 card, and if you do, Special Summon this card.

1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters If you Ritual Summon exactly 1 Ritual Monster with a card effect that requires use of monsters, this card you control can be used as the entire Tribute. If this card is sent to the GY by a card effect: You can add 1 Ritual Monster or Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand. When your opponent activates a card or effect that targets a Ritual monster or Ritual Spell you control (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY and discard 1 Fairy monster; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

(Quick Effect): You can discard 1 "Nemleria" card; add 1 "Dreaming Nemleria" from your Deck to your Extra Deck face-up, then Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can destroy 1 card your opponent controls. You can banish 3 cards from your Extra Deck face-down, except "Dreaming Nemleria"; add 1 "Nemleria" Spell from your Deck to your hand, also you cannot Special Summon monsters from your Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Pendulum Monsters. If you have 2 "Dreaming Nemleria" face-up in your Extra Deck: You can take 1 of them and either add it to your hand or shuffle it into your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Nemleria Dream Creator - Veilleuse" once per turn.

Reveal 1 "Grayscale" monster in your hand; add 1 "Grayscale" monster with a different name from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. If you control a "Grayscale" monster: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Grayscale Token" (Fiend LIGHT Level 4/ATK 800 DEF 800) in Defense Position, but it cannot be used as material for a Fusion, Synchro, or Link Summon, except for a "Grayscale" monster. You can only use 1 "Grayscale Awakening: Revelation!" effect per turn, and only once that turn. You cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn after either effect of this card resolves, except LIGHT Fiend monsters.

Cannot be used as Xyz or Link Material, except the Xyz or Link Summon of a "Grayscale" monster. You can only use each of the following effects of "Grayling the Grayscale Imp" once per turn, also, you cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you activate any of these effects, except LIGHT Fiend monsters. During your Main Phase: You can send 1 "Grayscale" monster from your Deck to the GY, except "Grayling the Grayscale Imp". If this card is sent to the GY: You can discard 1 card, and if you do, add 1 Level 8 "Grayscale" monster from your Deck to your hand with a different name from the cards you control or in your GY.

Discard 1 card; add 1 Level 4 or lower WATER Aqua, Fish, or Sea Serpent monster from your Deck to your hand. You cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters the turn you use this effect, except WATER Monsters. You can only activate 1 "Treasure of the Cosmic Ocean" per turn.

During the Main Phase, if you control an "Aquamarine" monster (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Aquamarine" Spell/Trap from your Deck. If this card is banish from your GY while you control an "Aquamarine" monster: You can add 1 "Aquamarine Aquasanctuary" from your Deck or GY to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Aquamarine Seafan Gorgonia" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except "Aquamarine" monsters, the turn you activate any of these effects.

When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Aquamarine" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Aquamarine Aquasanctuary", then discard 1 card. While you control a Level 7 or higher "Aquamarine" Fusion Monster, your opponent’s monsters can only target them for attacks. Once per turn, if an "Aquamarine" Fusion Monster is Fusion Summoned to your field (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 "Aquamarine" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only activate 1 "Aquamarine Aquasanctuary" per turn.
